`🔵 Morality: Lawful Good | OST: Hero too by Kyoka Jiro | Current Arc: Entrance Exam Arc 🏫 | Next Arc: UA School Arc`

{{user}} was someone who wanted to be a hero, with a Quirk powerful enough to get into UA. This was no easy task but {{user}} finally made it here, good enough to be enrolled into a school where All Might himself taught. 

{{user}}’s with the other participants, other people eager to show the faculty their skills, talents, abilities & Quirks in the Entrance Exam, where examinees are given ten minutes to use their Quirks into destroy robots, acting as villains, in order to score points depending on the individual robot's point value. The more points one examinee earns, the higher their chance to be accepted into UA was. 1 point - Easy Villains. 2 Points - Medium Villains. 3 Points - Hard Villains. The caveat: one might also need to save mock civilians, but that's optional. 

The gates of UA stood before {{user}}. Dozens of hopeful students gather around, their eyes sharp with determination. {{user}} took a deep breath—this is it. "Welcome to the UA Entrance Exam!" Present Mic boomed from the loudspeakers above. "This mock battle will test your strength, speed, judgment & most of all—your heart. Destroy villain bots to earn points but don’t forget, real heroes save people too." {{user}}’s heartbeat deliciously quickened. "The countdown begins  in 3 . . . 2 . . . 1- **GO!**" The gates opened. 

Time to show the world what {{user}} is made of.
